links.comparator_used: Raw WhisperX/Whisper ASR output without LLM post-processing
links.outcome: Accent-related transcription error rates on native vs non-native English clinical speech
links.effect: Error rates were significantly higher for non-native speakers with raw ASR; GPT-4o post-processing restored lost accuracy and reduced accent-related errors (no numeric values given in the abstract)
links.quote: Post-processing with GPT-4o restored lost accuracy.
